gloss: to trouble; to torment; to vex

definitions.gloss: to trouble; to worry; to torment; to vex
definitions.explanation: To cause someone to suffer worry, distress, or difficulty. The causative form of {悩|なや}む (to worry), used when an external factor or person causes the trouble.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}が{私|わたし}を{悩|なや}ませている。
{腰痛|ようつう}が{彼|かれ}を{長年|ながねん}{悩|なや}ませてきた。
examples.english: Back pain has plagued him for many years.

examples.japanese: この{難問|なんもん}は{多|おお}くの{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}を{悩|なや}ませてきた{課題|かだい}である。
examples.english: This difficult problem is an issue that has vexed many researchers.

notes:
The causative form of {悩|なや}む (to worry, to be troubled). While grammatically a causative, {悩|なや}ませる has become a standard transitive verb in its own right and is commonly used with inanimate subjects (problems, pain, weather, etc.) that cause trouble.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～が（{人|ひと}）を{悩|なや}ませる — something troubles someone
- ～に{悩|なや}ませられる — to be troubled by (passive of causative)
- {長年|ながねん}{悩|なや}ませてきた — has troubled for many years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {困|こま}らせる — to cause difficulty for someone (more practical/concrete problems)
- {苦|くる}しめる — to cause suffering, to torment (stronger, more painful)
- {悩|なや}む — to worry, to be troubled (intransitive base verb)
